english: Whoa, talk about the boonies!
Mmm, lovely.\nYou can tell the air itself has flavor out here.
…We're back here again.
Aria! I remember!
Shirayuki? You remember Rika and Rena?
Aria!
Shirayuki, do you remember me?
Yeah! I've got the explanation for everyone\nall organized in my head!
Let's hurry. The sooner we move,\nthe less time the enemy gets!
It's true - there are people who know\nabout Rika-chama.
I believe in Rika.\nThey must all be good people.
Lots of cute girls, just sis's type.
Mion, Satoko, and Shion too…
I don't really know who you are,\nbut you're protecting Rika-chan, right?\nAs club president, I'll help out!
Behold the exploits of Satoko Houjou,\nHinamizawa's trap master!
I'll provide all the support I can.
Everyone's such reliable friends.
Everyone! Please listen!\nI have something important to tell you!
//Fade to black; time passes
Wow! So this is some mysterious world!?
You believe it just like that…
Rika and the others are surely in everyone's memories.\nYou'll remember in time.
Please! Believe us!
If it's Shirayuki saying it,\nthen I believe it.
Me too!
'Cause it's Shirayuki-san, after all.
Thank you…
Nipaa~☆
So, what are our countermeasures\nagainst the enemy we're fighting?\nWhat should we do now, I wonder?
About that - it seems the enemy\nisn't a single faction.

Taking the Doctor Shinigami -
Rika-chan's killer - as confirmed,
who are those black versions of Rika-chan
and Rena-chan, I wonder?
We've encountered such people several times.\nThe Black Twin Angels appeared too.
There was someone who looked like my double, too.\nAre they a different force from Riko's group?
The black me said she'd use my power.\nAnd yet the Doctor Shinigami suddenly appeared\nand killed me.
How awful…
If that's true, they can't be working together.
Then while we're fighting one enemy,\nanother faction could target us.\nThat'd be bad, no?
How should we fight, I wonder?
I think I should leave\nHinamizawa for a while.
You mean go to another world?
Now that we know I'm the enemy's target,\nif I'm not here, no incident should happen\nin Hinamizawa.
It's only a temporary evacuation, but I think it's good.\nIn this world, some strange force is at work -\nwe can't avoid Rika dying.
Better to take out enemies like Riko, Jeanne,\nand the Doctor Shinigami in another world first,\nthen come back here. That should give us the advantage.
Agreed. No need to fight at a disadvantage.
Then we'll head for where Polyal is.
If they're after Rika-chan,\nthey're probably lying in ambush\nto stop us getting there.
Going straight there, we'd definitely be targeted.\nWe have to avoid fighting on two fronts.
So we should confuse the enemy?
Then it's easy, nyo.\nWe'll use Usada as a decoy\nto lure the enemy, nyo.
Why am I the decoy!?\nYou suggested it, Dejiko - YOU do it!
No way, nyo~.
But splitting into two groups is a good idea.\nThat'll force the enemy to split their forces too.
Couldn't the enemy just wait\nat Polyal's location?
With two factions, the scramble for Rika\nis first-come-first-served, right?\nIf they wait, they'll get beaten to her.
I see! It'll be a game of tag!
Tag instead of 'Demoning Away' -\nthat's a clever twist.
How do we split the teams?
How about a team of 5 IS units plus Rika, Satoko,\nLouise, Puchiko, and Kurumi? Carrying the little ones\nby IS gives us amazing mobility!
But then it's obvious Rika's with that group!
No - send the big team straight to Polyal's location,\nand have the IS team take a detour. That'll confuse them.
They'd have to consider both possibilities.
Let's go with that! The faster we move,\nthe more confused the enemy will be.
Yes! Swift and magnificent, desuu!
Sounds kinda wrong, but that sounds cool!
Like they say - 'clear the dishes quick'!
…'Strike while the iron is hot,' right!\nSomehow I feel like that's not wrong either.
//Fade to black; time passes
Now then - Rika and our splendid IS team,\nmove out!
Shouldn't that be 'merry'?
This is hardly a merry situation.
Now, now - let's stay reasonably relaxed.
Then, my bride, I'm off.
Yes! Take care of Rika-chan and the others!
Our decoy team moves out soon too!\nWe have to look like we'll reach Polyal first,\nor they'll figure out which one's the real team!
And we have to hit the weakened enemy\nas hard as we can once they've split their forces!
Exactly. We'll do it thoroughly!
Leave it to me!
I'll do my best too!
Alright! Move out!!
Yeah!!
//Battle map: plains\n//Our forces: Houki, Cecilia, Rin, Charlotte, Laura, Louise, Puchiko, Satoko, Rika, Kurumi
Enemy signatures detected! They're coming!
To detect movement in stealth mode…\nthis enemy is…?
They came to us! Let's do this!
Rin, you mustn't let your guard down.
I know… I remember what I did last time.
Rin…
This time I'll protect you, no matter what…!\nI won't let my guard down, no way!
A Rin who doesn't let her guard down\nis strong as a hundred. Nipaa~☆
Nipaa~☆
Here they come!
//Enemies appear. Black (Houki, Cecilia, Rin, Charlotte, Laura, Rika) and grunts.
That…!? IS units!!
They even have Akatsubaki…!?
I know what you're thinking, Rika.\nYou won't escape…!
Yes. Unfortunately for you,\nyou'll never win that way.
I already understand.\nWhy you're after me -\nand why you can never win.
Is that so, I wonder?
From what we know, those black IS units\nshould match our abilities. Everyone, be careful!
Fighting oneself is not pleasant.
It's strangely unsettling.
Protecting Rika and the others comes first, period.\nDon't get hung up on defeating them!
Right - keep the offense-defense balance in mind.
The plan: hold out until the other team\nsecures Polyal, then rush in all at once.\nSurvive until then, no matter what!
Got it!
Nyu.
I absolutely won't lose!\nBig brother, watch over me!
//Battle start
I don't know what you're planning,\nbut your aim won't succeed.
Do you think I'd act with no chance of winning?
There's no proof you're me.
I'll make you understand. Hehe!
//Conversation event when Black Rika and Rin clash
We meet again. Last time you outwitted me completely!\nNot this time!
Oh? You remember?
I'd forget if I could!\nBut carrying your regrets and living on -\nthat's what being human is!
Maybe. That's why, if we could redo things,\nwe'd want to - that's what makes us human.
//Conversation event when Black Houki clashes with someone
Silent, huh… Just who are you?
//Conversation event when Black Cecilia clashes with someone
No greeting at all - how rude!
//Conversation event when Black Rin clashes with someone
This one's got a bad attitude!\nWhat is this, harassment?
//Conversation event when Black Charlotte clashes with someone
Trying not to show your hand?\nHard to fight when I can't tell what you're thinking…
//Conversation event when Black Laura clashes with someone
Hmph, you could've at least come out\nin whiteface paint. How artless!
//Conversation event when Black Houki clashes with someone
Akatsubaki was only just completed…!\nWhy - how can it be replicated!
//Clear after a set number of turns
It's about time! Let's go!
Right!
We'll break through…!
…After them.
//All units vanish from the map.\n//Battle ends\n//Background: plains
Rika! Get on!
Yes!
Louise!
Fly steady now!
Satoko! Hold on!
Please! Cecilia!
Puchiko! Let's go!
Don't you drop me, nyu.
Angel, over here.
I'll drop bombs on our pursuers, okay?
If you're confident you won't fall.
Alright, let's fly!!
At this speed, hitting us should be hard!
We've shaken the black IS units!
Good! Let's rendezvous as planned!
Hm? Something's coming from behind!\nFast! It's catching up!
What!?
//SE: flight sound of something approaching
Approaching target. Scan: no problems.
What is that!?
The European Devil!!
Nothing else could close in at this speed!
Intercept!
No - keep running! Slowing down is dangerous!
Please… make it in time!
…Target acquired within range. Attack on standby.\nContinuing pursuit.
//END
